arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
work=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-optin-pr44.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch fix/20261031-two-admin-optin-intake https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$work"
cd "$work"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "e9c6620fdd81c3e9c9f38fa18f1b3c31bbc06d90"
git --no-pager diff --check HEAD
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -q
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B -c 'import ast,pathlib; fs=["scripts/organic_growth.py","scripts/safe_runtime.py","scripts/operation_policy.py"]; [ast.parse(pathlib.Path(x).read_text()) for x in fs]; print("AST_VERIFIED",len(fs))'
node --check ecosystem.config.js
grep -Fq '"join_requests", approve_pending_join_request,' scripts/safe_runtime.py
grep -Fq 'select_intake_account(state)' scripts/organic_growth.py
echo PR44_REMOTE_TESTS_PASS
